scope: Browser art review and deterministic result fixtures; not Unity, economy, save, drop RNG or real combat.

checks.name: Five source-based reward/route fixtures; redraw and duplicate advance do not settle twice or change growth wallet
Retreat shows undecided rewards and leads to existing retreat report
Failure recovery routes open existing formation and growth
Combat clear/fail alerts connect to results without leaving a growth sheet
Result blocks underlying summon/investment controls and cycles keyboard focus
Six states × two aspect ratios: 44px targets, scrollable details and fixed next action
390px browser touch opens reward details without horizontal overflow
Automatic clear advances after 1.5 seconds of real time
Details extend to original end +6 seconds; repeated clicks cannot extend indefinitely
Leaving results cancels pending automatic transition
